<thought>To meet the requirement of a single‑step synthesis, the most straightforward retrosynthetic disconnection is a McMurry coupling of two equivalents of 4‑methoxybenzaldehyde to give the target 4,4'‑dimethoxystilbene. All required reagents—4‑methoxybenzaldehyde, TiCl₄ and Zn—are commercially available and inexpensive (well under the $150 budget). A McMurry‑type coupling template exists in the database with ID **987654** (a generic “aldehyde‑to‑alkene McMurry coupling” template). Using this template, the retrosynthetic tree has the target molecule as the root, a single reaction node applying template 987654, and three leaf nodes for the commercially available reagents.</thought>
